findings.finding: NVM-UP upstream AP_OSD_MAX7456::check_font_char single burst vs AT7456E NVM read (would FAIL)
findings.detail: first CMDO read requested 2.4 us (data clocked out by 3.2 us) after CMM = 0x50 at 10 MHz, 4.8 / 6.4 us at this board's 5 MHz; AT7456E needs >= 22 us min, 30 us typ (DS p.36; MAX7456 0.5 us).  At 5 MHz the first 3 reads precede 22 us and 4 precede 30 us (at 10 MHz: 7 / 9) -> stale shadow RAM, check fails, update_font() rewrites all 256 chars (>= 3.8 s, NVM endurance 100000)

findings.finding: NVM-VM0 upstream VM0 = 0 -> CMAH/CMM gap vs AT7456E display-off time
findings.detail: 6.4 us at 5 MHz (3.2 at 10 MHz) vs up to 30 us typ (DS p.36); CMAH/CMM are ignored while VM0[3] is still set (DS p.29).  Harmless at boot (init() soft-reset leaves VM0 = 0) but the first character of a runtime font change (flush() -> update_font(), display on) is re-written needlessly

warnings.warn: V4b +3V3 tolerance vs AT7456E 3.15 V minimum
warnings.detail: at the repo's generic -5 % rail corner +3V3_OSD = 3.107 V < 3.15 V; the +3V3 regulator must be <= -3.7 % (typ. LDO/buck +/-2..3 % is fine)

warnings.warn: R3b HDZero Race V3 (4..12 V max) must not use the 12 V setting

PNLS6045-100M Isat 4.5 A < 5.8 A high-side limit: an output short can saturate L1 before hiccup (DS 10.2.2.7 'ideally Isat >= IHS_LIMIT'); valley limit + hiccup still protect the IC. Higher-Isat 6x6 10 uH part if short-circuit robustness is required

warnings.warn: S3 +/-6 % rail window vs worst-case error
